name: Rig designer
summary: Design a rig by talking to an agent and watching the topology assemble, then save it as a rig spec and start it.

surface.hint: say what the rig should do; watch it take shape, then start it

_drive_note: Uses the runtime's own drive channel (contract/drive.md), so there is no provider and nothing in calls{}. Ops are addressed to this surface and carry intent, never DOM instructions: {surface:'rig-designer', designer:{action:'set-rig'|'add-pod'|'add-seat'|'set-seat'|'remove'|'set-spec'|'reset', ...}}.
